description: This file is a PHP web page for adding or editing a secondary subnet configuration in a network gateway device. It includes PHP logic for handling GET parameters, fetching subnet data, and generating HTML/JavaScript for user interaction and form validation.

methods.name: initSubnetFields
methods.description: Initializes the subnet IP address and mask input fields based on the existing data fetched from the server.

methods.name: initValidation
methods.description: Sets up form validation rules using jQuery Validator, including custom method for netmask validation.

methods.name: onsave
methods.description: Gathers form data, performs validation, and sends an AJAX request to save the subnet configuration.
